_note: Event thresholds (tiles and seconds). Edit to tune; see pipeline/events.py.

overextended._note: ahead of the nearest teammate along the map's direction of play AND an enemy has a clear shot that no teammate can return

outnumbered._note: 2+ enemies have a clear shot at you and no teammate can shoot back at any of them

isolated_before_death._note: seconds in the window under fire that no teammate could return

crossfire._note: you and a teammate both had a clear shot at the same enemy from 45+ degrees apart

risky_push._note: ahead of the team where an enemy you lost sight of (bush / off screen, seen in the last 4 s) could have reached you
